newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil six-month trade gap seen at $6.9 bln-CNI.
newsitem.headline: Brazil six-month trade gap seen at $6.9 bln-CNI.

text.p: Brazil's trade gap in the six months to the end of March could hit $6.9 billion, according to the private National Industry Confederation (CNI).
The CNI said the deficit would hit $6.9 billion if the trade gap in March amounted to $1 billion as expected.
These figures are in "sharp contrast" with the trade deficit recorded for the whole of 1996 which stood at $5.5 billion, the CNI said.
It said the recent change in the currency exchange mini-band and retrictions on import financing indicated the government's concern in reducing the trade deficit.
((--Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151))
